title: 40 people told ICIG of reverse engineering program

tellings.quote: you have to be pretty darn weird to go to the ICIG, Inspector General, and say I was part of a I was part of a reverse engineering program. That's that's right. 40 people have done allegedly, right?

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that around 40 people have reportedly gone to the Inspector General of the Intelligence Community, a watchdog office that takes complaints from spy agency staff, and said they worked in a program taking apart non-human craft to learn how they work. He argues you would have to be very strange to make that claim to such an office if it were not true. If true, it would mean a secret effort to copy alien technology.
